name: Autumn Leaves
desc: Tumbling autumn leaves with edge-on flip physics drifting on the wind, pulled into a swirling vortex once per section and skittering along a ground line — rendered as rust-ochre painted leaves, riso misprint, flat silhouettes, or bare botanical vein wireframes.

style.doc: render philosophy: modeled rust-ochre painted leaf with veins / two-ink riso misregistration + halftone / flat cutout silhouette / non-representational botanical vein-skeleton wireframe

act.doc: multi-minute program: calm gentle fall / windy steady gusts / storm fast fall + frequent strong vortices
